newsitem.title: USA: Belden sees Q2 charge cutting EPS by $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Belden sees Q2 charge cutting EPS by $0.05.

text.p: Belden Inc said Wednesday that it expects its second quarter earnings to be cut by $0.05 a share from a charge of about $2 million.
However the company said it still expects record earnings in each quarter of 1997.

It cited declining prices for computer networking cables and said the charge will cover rebates related to the lower value of inventories held by distributors who participate in qualifying stocking programs.
The maker and marketer of wire, cable and cord products said it has been adjusting prices with the objective of enhancing market share.

"Protecting our distributor partners on their recent purchases just makes good sense. It strengthens our already good relationship with these important links in the distribution chain and allows them to immediately take advantage of lower prices when quoting Belden products," the company said in a statement Wednesday evening.
"Our lower cost position should mitigate much of the margin impact in the future. We continue to expect record earnings in each quarter of 1997."
